exposure: mobile health app use (Health Assistant app)
health perception at beginning of antenatal care
biopsychosocial characteristics (family income, medical history, medication adherence, lifestyle habits)
outcome: usability of mobile health app (Mobile App Usability Questionnaire score)
cohort: Pregnant women with high-risk pregnancies admitted to antenatal care at a public university hospital in southern Brazil.
finding: Cluster analysis revealed distinct profiles of high-risk pregnant women, enabling the identification of groups that could benefit from personalized digital interventions, and the Health Assistant app demonstrated good usability.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly more frequent in Cluster 3 (95.3%) compared to Clusters 1 (27.9%) and 2 (20.8%).
